get_execution_backend: get an execution backend instance by passing an ExecutionMode enum or string to get_execution_backend
maybe_update_settings_backend: update inference settings to use UMAS_FAST_GPU mode by calling maybe_update_settings_backend with settings and model config
ExecutionBackend_node_to_edge_wigner_per: gather node features and rotate L to M using ExecutionBackend node_to_edge_wigner_permute with node features and edge index
ExecutionBackend_permute_wigner_inv_edge: rotate M to L and scatter edge messages to nodes using ExecutionBackend permute_wigner_inv_edge_to_node
UMASFastGPUBackend_validate: validate that model parameters are compatible with the UMASFastGPUBackend by calling validate with lmax, mmax, and settings
